texts:
This mocap package saves a face recording from the browser as a clip you can replay on a different avatar. The clip stores ARKit blendshapes, 52 per frame plus head pose, not keyframes baked to one rig.

npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/mocap
Each clip carries a format string, three.ws.face-mocap.v1, and the player checks it before replay, so a newer clip cannot load on an older player and mangle the face.
Clips are private by default. Set one public and attach a $THREE price to list it. Record your own in the browser at three.ws/mocap-studio
